sections.Profile:
Williams' Fun House, released in August 1956, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Harry Williams with artwork by Roy Parker.

- Manufacturer: Williams Electronic Games Inc.
- Years made: 1956
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Good Times, Wood Rail, Circus, Clowns, Original Theme
sections.Design Team:
- Art: Roy Parker
- Design: Harry Williams
